title: Imbalance Conjecture
exact_target: If every edge joins vertices of different degrees, must the edge degree-differences be the vertex degrees of some simple graph?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 1438 (GRAPH-051). CC BY 4.0.
James Alexander Schreib and Yousof Yavari, A Proof of the Imbalance Conjecture, arXiv:2608.09191v3 (2026), Section 1 and Theorem 1.1.
